candidate_workaround: After any lifecycle document changes, refresh the logical manifest before rerunning phase-local tests and validators, then verify the exact changed-file hashes rather than weakening manifest parity.
failure_signature: The first lifecycle test run failed because phase-truth, checklist, and wellbeing content changed after the evidence manifest had been frozen, leaving three stale logical hashes.
recurrence_guard: Treat lifecycle receipt generation as a manifest-affecting mutation and refresh the manifest before any closeout validator is credited.
rollback: Give the failed lifecycle run zero validation credit, retain all three stale-hash findings, and stop before the closeout commit until exact manifest parity is restored.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded closeout recovery only; no broader assurance or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Refresh logical manifest after lifecycle receipt mutation
trigger_preconditions: phase lifecycle documents changed after evidence freeze
